sloka: यत् यत् पश्यामि सर्वस्य ग्रहणम् साधु रोचये ।अवश्यम् ग्रहणम् रामो मन्ये अहम् समुपैष्यति ॥३-७१-१७॥
transliteration: yat yat paśyāmi sarvasya grahaṇam sādhu rocaye ।avaśyam grahaṇam rāmo manye aham samupaiṣyati ॥3-71-17॥

translations.english: O Rama, I was struggling to preserve my body all the time thinking that some day you would certainly come into my arms.
